entities.summary: Saudi, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with Second Saudi State and Rashidi Rivalry (1824–1891). Preceded by Second Saudi State and Turki ibn Abdullah recaptures Riyadh and founds the Second Saudi State. Their legacy influenced Rashidi forces capture Riyadh; Al-Saud family flees to Kuwait and Rashidi Ascendancy and Saudi Exile.
